entities.title: Validate specification
entities.summary: One job, structural, on ubuntu-latest with Python 3.12: install tools/requirements.txt, run the structural checks, then check the side-by-side page.
entities.trigger: Every push to any branch, and every pull request.
checks: python3 tools/validate.py: the schema, the conformance examples and fixtures, the JSON examples in spec/*.md, and the falsehoods matrix against its scenarios (tools/.dev/operation.json, validate-structure).
python3 tools/side_by_side.py --check: docs/side-by-side.md matches the five libraries' marked UTV-first tests (tools/.dev/operation.json, check-side-by-side).
entities.blocks: A failing step fails the run, which shows on the commit and the pull request. Nothing in the repository says the default branch requires it to pass.
notChecked: No library is built and no library's tests run: dotnet test, mvn -q test, the Python unittest suite, npm test and cargo test (AGENTS.md section 3) run only where a contributor runs them.
The everyday and text-form fixtures are checked for shape only; whether each library produces the expected outcomes is checked only by that library's tests.

That the Python package's bundled schema, implementations/python/src/utv/data/utv-1.0.schema.json, is still identical to schema/utv-1.0.schema.json: only the Python test BundledSchema compares them (implementations/python/src/utv/data/.dev/backlog.json, schema-copy-outside-ci).
The semantic scenarios are not executable (OI-12).
The HASD validators, Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py and Meta/Agents/Knowledge/validate_knowledge.py, do not run.
Whether every library marks every side-by-side task (tools/.dev/backlog.json, side-by-side-missing-tasks-pass).
